title: 第15章 也是幸运了一次第16章 狩猎开始
content_zh:
天微亮，东方还没有出鱼露白的时候，应无悔就已经醒来，旁边的安安还在呼呼大睡。
做好早饭，应无悔用最近打猎得来的兔皮和鹿皮，用自制的石针，穿针引线，做了一件衣服，还有一件裤子，这是给安安特别定制的，天气逐渐转冷，她一个小孩子，是最容易受冻的，兽皮衣服给安安盖上，裤子放在她旁边，自己要出门了，开始继续找寻灵草。
应无悔向狱火行者请教了许多关于灵草的知识，也问了一些常见的异能兽样貌名字，这样自己在外面，就可以更好的应对。
一级异能中阶冲到高阶，对于应无悔来说，还是有一些难度，他感觉心景中的异能，越难越积累，往上面堆积，只有堆满了，才是一级异能高阶。
应无悔先走到标记的老地方，由标记的地方开始行走，然后向不断未知的地方前进，中途一样要做标记。
山里的甬道内，还是老样子，阴冷潮湿，灰暗无光。
经过两个多小时的快速前进，终于到原来的标记点。
应无悔随便挑了一条路，继续前进。
里面的蝙蝠倒挂着，一有人进来，并睁开绿色的眼睛，那一只又一只的，就像地狱中的幽灵一样，可能第一次来会被吓到，但这是应无悔第二次来了。
在地球上的时候，应无悔玩鬼屋游戏的时候都毫无惧色，毕竟那些都是由人扮演的，而在这个大陆上，一切都有可能，而且都是真实的，这和虚假的完全无法比拟。
前方有微微的蓝光闪烁，把山洞里的影子照得摇曳抖动。
难道是？应无悔立马向前跑去，蓝光越来越亮，是幽火草！
还有这个是什么，长得像莲花一样。
十几株幽火草，长在这个山洞内，这里应该异能能量茂盛，才可以孕育出这么多灵草，还有这朵花，应该也是稀有品种，毕竟幽火草都变成常见的了，不管了，先带回去，今天收获颇丰，应无悔将它们全部都装入蛇皮袋中。
满满当当的收获，让他返回的路程中，分外开心，也是幸运了一次，以前一直倒霉，终于转运了现在。
这么多的幽火草，还有这朵花，顺便回去时还采了一些野蘑菇，回去炖蛇汤也还不错，将近中午，应无悔就回到山洞当中，“安安，我回来了！
你看这是什么，野生大蘑菇！”
安安开心地跑过来，这一个蘑菇有一口碗那么大，而且我根据地球的经验，这种颜色平平淡淡的蘑菇，不可能有毒。
“狱火行者！
你出来看！”

应无悔向洞穴深处叫道，狱火行者立马飘了出来，“你小子今天运气可以啊！
固元花都找得到！”
地上摆着十几株幽火草，还有一朵粉色的花。
content_en:
When the sky was slightly bright and the dew had not yet appeared in the east, Ying Wuhui had already woken up. An An was still sleeping soundly next to him.
After making breakfast, Ying Wuhui used the rabbit skins and deer skins that he had recently hunted, and used homemade stone needles to thread the needles and threads to make a piece of clothing and a pair of trousers, which were specially customized for An An. The weather was getting colder, and she, a child, was the most vulnerable to the cold. He covered An An with the animal skin clothes and put the trousers next to her. He was about to go out and continued to look for spiritual herbs.
Ying Wuhui asked the Hellfire Walker for a lot of knowledge about spiritual herbs, and also asked about the names of some common supernatural beasts, so that he could better deal with them outside.
It is still difficult for Ying Wuhui to reach the high level from the middle level of the first-level superpower. He feels that the more difficult the superpowers in his mind are, the more they accumulate. Only when the pile is full can the first-level superpower be high-level.
You should first walk to the old marked place without regrets, start walking from the marked place, and then move forward to the unknown place, making marks along the way.
The corridor in the mountain is still the same, cold, damp, and dark.
After more than two hours of rapid progress, we finally reached the original marking point.
Ying Wuhui chose a random path and moved on.
The bats inside were hanging upside down. As soon as someone came in and opened their green eyes, one after another appeared, like ghosts in hell. They might be frightened the first time they came, but this was the second time Ying Wuhui came.
When he was on Earth, Ying Wuhui had no fear when playing haunted house games. After all, they were all played by people, but on this continent, everything was possible and all real, which was completely incomparable with the fake ones.
There was a faint blue light flickering ahead, making the shadows in the cave sway.
Could it be? Ying Wuhui immediately ran forward. The blue light became brighter and brighter. It was the Nether Fire Grass!
And what is this? It looks like a lotus.
More than a dozen ghost fire grasses grow in this cave. There should be a lot of supernatural energy here to breed so many spiritual grasses. This flower should also be a rare species. After all, ghost fire grass has become common. No matter what, let's take it back first. Today's harvest is quite fruitful. Ying has no regrets about putting them all in a snakeskin bag.
The abundant harvest made him extremely happy on the way back. He also got lucky for once. He had been unlucky before, but finally things turned around.
There were so many fire grasses and this flower. I also picked some wild mushrooms when I went back. It was not bad to stew snake soup. It was almost noon, and Ying Wu regretted going back to the cave, "An'an, I'm back!
Look what this is, a wild mushroom! "
An An ran over happily. This mushroom was as big as a bowl, and based on my experience on the earth, this kind of dull-colored mushroom could not be poisonous.
"Hellfire Walker!
Come out and see! "
Ying Wuhui shouted into the depths of the cave, and the Hellfire Walker immediately floated out, "You guys are lucky today!
Guyuan flowers can be found! "
There are more than a dozen ghost fire grasses and a pink flower on the ground.
